description: This file defines function prototypes, macros, and includes for parameter handling in the cURL tool, part of the cURL project. It provides declarations for functions related to converting strings to numbers, reading files into memory, and protocol checks, specifically tailored for the command-line tool parameter processing.

methods.name: new_getout
methods.description: Creates and returns a new getout structure based on the provided operation configuration.

methods.name: file2string
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string buffer.

methods.name: file2memory
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into memory, allocating sufficient space.

methods.name: str2num
methods.description: Converts a string to a long number.

methods.name: str2unum
methods.description: Converts a string to an unsigned long number.

methods.name: oct2nummax
methods.description: Converts an octal string to a number, with a maximum limit.

methods.name: str2unummax
methods.description: Converts a string to unsigned number with a maximum limit.

methods.name: secs2ms
methods.description: Converts seconds in string form to milliseconds.

methods.name: proto2num
methods.description: Converts protocol string to its numeric representation based on the operation configuration.

methods.name: check_protocol
methods.description: Checks the validity of a protocol string.

methods.name: str2offset
methods.description: Converts a string to a curl_off_t offset value.

methods.name: get_args
methods.description: Retrieves command-line arguments for the operation configuration.

methods.name: add2list
methods.description: Adds a string to a curl_slist list.

methods.name: ftpfilemethod
methods.description: Sets FTP file transfer method based on string input.

methods.name: ftpcccmethod
methods.description: Sets FTP CCC method based on string input.

methods.name: delegation
methods.description: Sets delegation level based on string input.

methods.name: str2tls_max
methods.description: Converts string to a TLS maximum version number.
